messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike + routing fallback loop detected for customer 'AcmePayments' on eu-west-1 (service: routing-service). auto-escalation -> pager. 

sre_oncall_jordan: @channel getting paged — errors spiking ~12% for /v1/generate for Acme. Dash shows repeated fallback to variant 'chat-small-v2' despite request type=embeddings.

prod_support_maya: Customer reported embeddings suddenly returning long prose paragraphs instead of vectors. They opened a support ticket with sample output. Priority: customer-facing.

runtime_eng_lee: I see the trace: routing-policy pinned version 2024-12-embed-15 on alias acme/embeds, but the pinned variant mapping in the model catalog has matcher="chat" for that version due to bad metadata. So requests get routed to chat runtime, then runtime returns 415/422/500 cascades.

sre_oncall_jordan: can you paste the routing lines / logs?

runtime_eng_lee: logs:
```
2024-11-09T13:45:02Z routing-service: req_id=abc123 alias=acme/embeds model_alias_pin=2024-12-embed-15 resolved_variant=chat-small-v2 fallback_policy=allow_fallback -> dispatch(chat-small-v2)
2024-11-09T13:45:02Z inference-proxy: dispatch failed: schema_mismatch: expected=embedding_batch got=chat_stream
```

runtime_eng_lee: Also found the model catalog entry: `variant_family: chat` for version 2024-12-embed-15 (should be `embed`). Looks like the metadata change happened during onboarding last week.

prod_support_maya: Customer impact: Acme is using embeddings to power similarity search in checkout fraud flow. They saw degraded results and increased false positives. They emailed support with a screenshot of 7 failed inference calls over last 10 minutes.

sre_oncall_jordan: Pager duty: @runtime_eng_lee take lead on mitigation. @prod_support_maya coordinate comms. I'll start throttling/isolating traffic to minimise blast radius.

runtime_eng_lee: Mitigation plan (short):
1) Temporarily disable fallback for alias acme/embeds so routing-service will 429 instead of routing to incompatible variant. Command: `curl -XPOST $ROUTER/admin/pinments/disable_fallback -d '{"alias":"acme/embeds"}'`
2) Unpin the wrong version from the alias: `PATCH /routing/alias/acme/embeds` -> remove pin 2024-12-embed-15
3) Re-pin correct embedding variant (2024-11-embed-09) which we verified in catalog.
4) Push hotfix to catalog metadata to fix family tag to `embed` and add validation to onboarding pipeline.

oncall_next_alex: If we disable fallback we'll cause 429s for some traffic; acceptable to prevent wrong outputs. Confirming blow-up tradeoff.

prod_support_maya: Agreed — tell Acme we're throttling to mitigate incorrect outputs. I'll open a quick status message.

sre_oncall_jordan: Executing step 1 now.

ops_bot: command: disable_fallback alias=acme/embeds -> accepted (op_id=op-7721)

sre_oncall_jordan: Done. Watching metrics. 5xx rate dropping, but error_type switched to 429/validation instead of 500. Good sign.

runtime_eng_lee: Unpinning bad version now.

ops_bot: command: update_alias alias=acme/embeds remove_pin=2024-12-embed-15 -> accepted (op_id=op-7722)

runtime_eng_lee: Re-pinning to 2024-11-embed-09

ops_bot: command: update_alias alias=acme/embeds add_pin=2024-11-embed-09 -> accepted (op_id=op-7723)

runtime_eng_lee: Catalog patch queued: PR #4123 updating variant_family for 2024-12-embed-15 from 'chat' -> 'embed' and adding schema validation tests. Will merge once CI green.

prod_support_maya: Sent Acme status: short note that we detected routing misconfiguration, temporarily throttled to prevent incorrect outputs, and rolling to correct variant. Asking for impact logs if they have more.

customer_success_sam: Pinging account exec too. Need to offer: post-incident call and root-cause note.

sre_oncall_jordan: Metrics look normalizing. Latency back to baseline for embeddings path and false positive alerts from Acme are dropping. I'll keep pager open for 30m.

runtime_eng_lee: Afterpin validation run results:
```
> curl -XPOST /v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["hello world"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
<- 200 OK with embedding vector len=1536
```

sre_oncall_jordan: Excellent. Next: temporary mitigations -> remove once catalog PR merged and we run a full canary. Action items:
- runtime_eng_lee: merge PR #4123, run canary, add onboarding validation (assign you)
- prod_support_maya: follow up with Acme for postmortem call and offer credits if needed
- customer_success_sam: coordinate exec outreach
- oncall_next_alex: take watch for next 12h, escalate if recurrence

prod_support_maya: Recording incident start=1758022331 end=1758022710 impact=AcmePayments embeddings degraded -> incorrect outputs & increased false positives; mitigation applied: disable_fallback + re-pin correct variant.

sre_oncall_jordan: Closing pager. Marking SEV3. Raising follow-up retro.

runtime_eng_lee: Quick note for postmortem: root cause = model catalog metadata mislabel (variant_family wrong) + lack of validation during onboarding + permissive fallback policy that allowed routing to incompatible variant. Recommend: strict metadata validation, fail-fast routing when model_variant_family mismatch, and add a safety check in fallback that ensures schema compatibility before routing to a different family.

prod_support_maya: I'll create the incident ticket with timestamps and attach customer logs.

incident-bot: Incident updated: SEV3 -> mitigated. Postmortem requested: owners=[runtime_eng_lee, prod_support_maya], due in 72h.

oncall_next_alex: @runtime_eng_lee I'll pick up canary tomorrow morning at 09:00 CET.

runtime_eng_lee: Thanks everyone. Quick doc link for the team: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallbacks — I'll add notes.

prod_support_maya: +1. Closing thread when postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
